## Files

- `specimens.dxf`: one block per specimen, named `<type>__<orientation>deg__<n>` (discs: `<type>__<n>`), canonical pose, layers `Q3_NORMAL` / `Q4_MEDIUM` / `Q5_HIGH` (colours 3 / 4 / 5), millimetres. The model space shows all blocks in a grid with their names.
- `index.csv`: one line per block: type, orientation to the rolling direction, axis angle in the source drawing (degrees from +Y, counter-clockwise, towards the code), source sheet and position, size, holes, notch-code signature, repair applied.
- `repaired_source.dxf`: the source drawing after repair, without blocks (check it with `check_sheet.py`).
